subject: Important update: Your upcoming flight details
body: Dear [Recipient], We wanted to inform you that there has been a change in your upcoming flight schedule. Your flight from New York to London has been rescheduled to depart two hours earlier. Please check your updated itinerary for the new timing. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact our customer service team. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for choosing to fly with us. Best regards, Airlines Customer Support
